messages.subject: rCharts for histogram?
parts:
Is there an easy way to plot histogram using rCharts?

I'm also frustrated about the lack of documentation of rCharts. Plots have so many things to adjust but it's hard to figure out what arguments each function can take.

One small bug report, for polycharts, somehow the bar plot cannot take categories (x-axis) with dots in the names. I found that because I wanted to use it to plot histogram, but if x-axis has categories like "1.5", polycharts would fail.
